senses.gloss:
वी I. €2 P. (वेति, rarely used in classical literature)
—1 To go, move.
—2 To approach.
—3 To pervade.
—4 To bring, convey.
—5 To throw, cast.
—6 To eat, consume.
—7 to obtain.
—8 To conceive, bring forth.
—9 To be born or produced.
—10 To shine, be beautiful.
—11 To desire, wish.
—12 To shine. ━II. (वि + इ) €2 P.
—1 To go away, depart; तस्यामहं त्वयि च संप्रति वीतचिन्तः Ś. 4. 13;
 so वीतभय, वीतक्रोध, etc.
—2 To undergo a change; सदृशं त्रिषु लिङ्गेषु यन्न व्येति तदव्ययम् Sk.
—3 To spend.
—4 To be diffused, to spread.
—5 To vanish, disappear.
—6 To cross over, traverse.
